scripts.deployDns: npm run build && cdk deploy --app "node -e \"require('./bin/dns.js')\"" --require-approval never
scripts.deployBackend: npm run build && cdk deploy --app "node -e \"require('./bin/backend.js')\"" -O cdk-infra.json --require-approval never
scripts.deployBackend:dev: npm run build && cdk deploy --app "node -e \"require('./bin/backend.js')\"" -O cdk-infra.json --require-approval never --all -c stage=dev
scripts.deployBackend:qa: npm run build && cdk deploy --app "node -e \"require('./bin/backend.js')\"" -O cdk-infra.json --require-approval never --all -c stage=qa
scripts.deployBackend:prod: npm run build && cdk deploy --app "node -e \"require('./bin/backend.js')\"" -O cdk-infra.json --require-approval never --all -c stage=prod
scripts.deployFrontend: npm run build && cdk deploy --app "node -e \"require('./bin/frontend.js')\"" --require-approval never
scripts.deployFrontend:dev: npm run build && cdk deploy --app "node -e \"require('./bin/frontend.js')\"" --require-approval never -c stage=dev
scripts.deployFrontend:qa: npm run build && cdk deploy --app "node -e \"require('./bin/frontend.js')\"" --require-approval never -c stage=qa
scripts.deployFrontend:prod: npm run build && cdk deploy --app "node -e \"require('./bin/frontend.js')\"" --require-approval never -c stage=prod
